Cloud Data Platforms

Modernization is an engineering-control problem, not a copy exercise.

Cloud modernization succeeds when business meaning, controls, and operational reliability survive the platform change.

Chalapathi KoneniSenior Data Engineering LeaderEngineering work →Research →

A governed migration model

Moving data to a cloud platform requires explicit treatment of business keys, partitions, change indicators, reconciliation, access governance, operational monitoring, and downstream compatibility.

What matters in practice

  • Preserve business semantics during platform change.
  • Separate operational systems from analytical workloads without weakening controls.
  • Design for cost visibility, ownership, and authorized access.
  • Validate completeness, freshness, and restartability before declaring success.
